notes: Layering matches architecture.json exactly (routes/services/repositories/models at declared paths); boundary is pure FastAPI + Pydantic validation delegating to StockService, never touches the ORM/session (repository is the sole touchpoint). NFR-F1-quantity-integrity and NFR-F1-sku-location-uniqueness are enforced at both the DB constraint (CheckConstraint quantity>=0, UniqueConstraint sku+location) and service/repository upsert layers. NFR-F1-durability-migrations: created_at/actor are service-stamped and model-immutable, defended by a migration-reversibility fitness test. NFR-F1-field-named-validation: StockValidationError carries field+message, rendered by the boundary as {field, message} JSON (renders_via: react, no server HTML). NFR-F1-config-in-env: DB resolves via app/database.get_db/env, no hardcoded DSN. NFR-F1-spa-json-boundary: client/ is a separate React+TS SPA with its own component/e2e tests; app/main.py's client/dist mount is correctly guarded by os.path.isdir so it is a no-op in dev/API-only contexts (no import-time build coupling). No duplicate class definitions, no flat-vs-package staleness. No concrete rubric-cited improvement identified.
